facts.text: Eat now. The tournament starts at dawn, and I don't fight on an empty stomach.
facts.why: Lee never says this. His real lines on the Wikiquote page include this one about his style, said to Parsons.
facts.fix: My style? You can call it the art of fighting without fighting.

fix_note.text: My style? You can call it the art of fighting without fighting.

facts.text: Roper's toast, right before he bets the lot.
facts.why: Roper is shown betting on a golf shot and an insect fight and offering to bet Lee, but no toast or banquet bet appears. Wikipedia calls him a gambler in debt to the mob.
facts.fix: For Roper, who will bet on anything.

vibe.verdict: A handsome banquet card with the metal hand and the hall of mirrors, but none of Lee's lines make it onto the table.
missing: 'Don't think, feel! It is like a finger pointing away to the moon.' (Lee to Lahn)

Roper beating Bolo in the square (the melee)
Han's underground drug lab and the acid pit (Han's tour for Roper)
